RagShortTexts: Outbuildings at Midhowe include ironworking remains, with some construction over an earlier ditch.

Variants.Content: Outbuildings at Midhowe include ironworking remains, with some construction over an earlier ditch. Expanding habitation and production could alter older defenses. Tool repair needed fuel, iron and work space; possession of a tower did not make its occupants self-sufficient in every craft.
